Hero_Desc_Pira:
At first glance, she looks like gold, but she's actually a pyrite dragon that wanted to be gold.
Resentful of her inherent limitations, she has fallen into the life of a loan shark.
Will there ever come a day when Pira fully accepts herself?
Album_Hobby_Pira: Appraising goods she obtained through shady loans.
Album_Pira1: Pira is a dragon known among her kind for being particularly eccentric. She has an extreme inferiority complex about gold, so it's best not to mention it in her presence. But getting furious just from hearing the word "gold..." isn't that a bit too sensitive?
Album_Pira2: I had heard rumors that Pira was actually quite intelligent, but after meeting her, she was nothing short of a delinquent. She swaggered around, picking fights and approaching others with a threatening tone, asking if they needed money. I almost handed her some cash out of fear.
Album_Pira3: Pira isn't just a dragon—she's a ruthless loan shark who lends her gold to dragons and other races, then extorts them with exorbitant interest rates. Her methods are so vicious that even Sist was appalled and warned me never to borrow money from her.
Album_Pira4: Pira researches stones to obtain a mystical ore called "Pyro-Goldstone". Seeing her suddenly put on a serious face, I got curious and asked why. She said she needed it to truly become a golden dragon.
Album_Pira5: Leets holds Pira in high regard. She claims that without Pira's advice, she would have never toughened up and broken free from her soft and undisciplined past. However, Pira simply scoffs, saying she just threw a few words at Leets when she saw her doing something foolish...
Album_Pira6: Pira collects any stone that looks remotely unusual. Recently, she even traded her entire loan portfolio for what appeared to be a rare river stone. When I asked why, she said that among these stones might be the Sage's Stone she's been desperately seeking. When I asked if she didn't feel like she was wasting money, she casually revealed a shocking truth—every single gold coin she lends is actually counterfeit, made from Pyrite.
Album_Pira7: A loan shark running a counterfeit gold operation... According to Daya, Pira used to be a decent dragon at some point. Maybe there's still a chance for her redemption? If she ever finds that elusive Sage's Stone she's so desperate for, perhaps she'll regain her former self.

LoveHeroCancel_Pira: Tch... ya just blew a golden chance, ya fool!
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Hate1: Without taking a bite, Pira said she never liked how it glowed all bright and sparkly. But it would have been good if she had tried it...
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Hate2: Pira flared up, asking why she was being punished when she hadn't done anything wrong recently. Her reaction makes it seem like there might be something more to it...
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like1: Pira reminisced, saying it was similar to the drinks she would occasionally offer when welcoming clients. Surprisingly, it seems she does treat her own clients with hospitality
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like10: She ate with a deeply thoughtful expression, then suddenly rushed out of the banquet hall, saying she had conceived an incredible business idea. What could it have been?
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like2: When life as a dragon was bitter, it was the only candy that comforted her, Pira said, beginning to tell tales of the old dragon streets. Somehow, it felt like a story I'd heard before...
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like3: I explained that it was food eaten for the New Year, and Pira excitedly interpreted it on her own, asking if eating it would make her a new dragon. I didn't bother to correct her.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like4: Pira asked if the Order's situation was so dire that we had to serve wood instead of food, and I barely managed to stop her from offering a loan. After clearing up the misunderstanding, she enjoyed the meal.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like5: Pira seemed pleased, thinking it would be easy to eat while wandering around the surface. When I asked where she was wandering off to, she didn't answer me.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like6: When I said it was a popular food among the Denizens, she asked about the history of Songpyeon. She mentioned something about needing to create a connection with her clients.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like7: Pira complained that a grown dragon doesn't eat such sweets, but she wouldn't let go of the Almond Pralines. It seems she really liked them.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like8: Pira muttered seriously that this sourness was nothing, compared to her bitter life. But, she couldn't hide her scrunched-up face.
Food_ChefNote_Pira_Like9: Pira persistently asked who came up with this. I thought she was asking to bully them, but it turned out that she just wanted to propose a partnership.

LoveLetter_Pira:
Boss, Boss. It is Pira. Relax, this is not a letter telling you to take out a loan.

I am only writing because I appreciate all the ways you have looked after me, so do not think too much of it. I used to wonder why everyone followed you around like that, but now I think I am beginning to understand. If I find another promising business opportunity, I will quietly contact you, so do not miss your chance.

I will see you again, Boss.
LoveCall_Pira:
Boss, you doing well?
I am doing fine, same as always!
I have always been grateful to you, Boss, but saying it out loud was too embarrassing.
Still, I suppose a person ought to do something this sappy at least once.
Thanks for always giving me so much support.

Lately, I have been lying low without getting into any scraps, and it is getting a little boring.
No need to worry.
I will not cause trouble and drive a nail through your heart, Boss.
If you ever need cash in a hurry, contact me anytime.
I will lend you as much as you need, interest-free.
Between you and me, Boss, is trust not what matters?
You trusted me, and I trust you just as much.
How about we meet up soon and catch up properly?
And do not say 'next time.' No, no~ I will be waiting, so call me.
